Lived on Tangier Island or visited? Tell us what we got right or missed.

About two hundred fifty people share about 83 acres of high ground in the Chesapeake Bay, and the mailboat from Crisfield is the front door. Would you stay through a winter when ice stops the boats, or would you leave? Tell us below.
